## Working Rules

- Every governed tracked file has exactly one department owner.
- Domain-specific UI belongs to its product department; only shared shell and widget code belongs to Editor Shell and Drafting UI.
- Tests belong to the department whose behavior they prove.
- A capability is not accepted until automated evidence and any required manual product test are recorded.
- Ownership or wiring changes update this map in the same change.

See [TEST_QUEUE.md](TEST_QUEUE.md) for work awaiting hands-on inspection.
See [DEPENDENCIES.md](DEPENDENCIES.md) for current direct include flow and the highest cross-department fan-out files.
